# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose Kerr is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome man with good features, a Roman nose, and open gray eyes. For fifteen years, he wore a river-like, wavy brown beard reaching almost to his knees and a dense deluge of rippling brown hair hanging down his back. After finally shaving and cutting his hair, he revealed a firm, smooth-shaven chin.

_Sources: [v1 c29 P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 c29 P14](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0014), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a clever, sharp, and widely read man who possesses a great sense of humor and enjoys a hearty debate. He is an exceptionally talented storyteller and a fine dancer. A passionate partisan, he holds unyielding political convictions and maintains a stubborn, resolute nature.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c28 P12](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0012), [v1 c28 P15](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0015), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c9 P22](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0022)_

## History

Ambrose Kerr campaigned fiercely as a Liberal during an election fifteen years prior to the events of the novel, publicly vowing never to shave his beard or cut his hair until his party returned to office. He kept his vow for fifteen years, growing his hair and beard to immense lengths. He courted Miss Winifred Tolley for over two decades, though she refused to marry him while he maintained his unkempt vow. During his time at Seven Gulls, he frequently spent time at the lighthouse with Captain Saul, sharing stories and singing old Scotch ballads. When a national election finally returned the Liberals to power, he immediately forced a local barber out of bed at midnight to shave his beard and trim his hair. Following this fulfillment of his vow, he married Miss Winifred Tolley and moved into her home near the harbor.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 c28 P10](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0010), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c28 P12](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0012), [v1 c29 P14](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0014), [v4 c9 P9](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0009), [v4 c9 P10](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0010), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028), [v4 c9 P29](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0029), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_
